description: Exact-tip native CUDA host and device evidence for the legacy per-device typed-attention arm fix.
method: Each device case ran in a separate process with --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture. The two-device regression also used --ignored and switches devices 0, 1, then 0; it compares all output values against a host numerical reference. Other cases run on the default device with two devices visible. Adaptive=true sets FIFI_CUDA_ATTN_PREFILL_ADAPT=1; false unsets it.

memory_admission.note: 8192 MiB minimum per card and at least prior service usage plus 256 MiB; a guard, not a measured rig footprint

limitations: A synthetic attention fixture, not the Qwen served model.
The causal and tile-boundary tests use the default GPU; the regression test switches both GPUs.
No measurement of prefill/decode throughput or 128k/256k context inference.
The tested source is based on the local b61 adaptive integration, not the distinct public head of zbrdc/fifi#36.
Guard samples are periodic observations, not a continuous hardware trace.
